source_text: UNAIDS-supported simulations forecast that maintaining VMMC through 2030 could avert 2–5 million infections across eastern and southern Africa, with cumulative savings exceeding program costs by factors of 2–10 under 3–5% discount rates, assuming stable heterosexual transmission dynamics.
